title: Simultaneously Minimizing Storage and Bandwidth Under Exact Repair With Quantum Entanglement
summary: We study exact-regenerating codes for entanglement-assisted distributed storage systems. Consider an $(n,k,d,α,β_{\mathsf{q}},B)$ distributed system that stores a file of $B$ classical symbols across $n$ nodes with each node storing $α$ symbols. A data collector can recover the file by accessing any $k$ nodes. When a node fails, any $d$ surviving nodes share an entangled state, and each of them transmits a quantum system of $β_{\mathsf{q}}$ qudits to a newcomer.
